# Kenney Mini Characters 1.0

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-characters — by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0 (see `License.txt`).

Only the twelve character GLB files and their shared `Textures/colormap.png` are kept. They are
inputs for `pnpm art:cast` (`art/blender/build_cast.py`); the site never loads them directly.
